Following today's "Surprise and Shine" event, Apple has updated its official Design Resources website with new product bezel materials for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Details below.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro bezel materials now available

Designers should be familiar with Apple's Design Resources website, a platform that offers various hardware and software materials for designers to use in their own work.

Content includes Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG materials for Apple platforms, products, and technologies, as well as fonts, SF Symbols, Apple Icon Composer, and badges and logos for services like Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

Following today's announcement of the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, Apple has updated the Design Resources website with Photoshop and PNG materials for both new devices.

The materials include both open and folded versions of the iPhone Duo in two colour options, as well as iPhone 18 Pro models featuring a smaller Dynamic Island.

To view the new bezel materials and other existing materials on the Design Resources website, click here.
